notes.title: The crossing is not the threshold
notes.description: For the surface code with a union-find decoder, the curves of small code distances cross well below the threshold, and the crossing climbs from 7.4% to about 10% as the distance grows to 21.
notes.plain: Researchers often read how much noise a code tolerates off the point where two curves cross. For small codes that point is too low: here 7.4% instead of about 10%.
